subject: general
question:
The sides of a rectangular field are 11 m and 14 m long. Its area is equal to the area of a circular field. What is the circumference (in m) of the circular field? 

{Take } pi = (22)/(7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of **rectangular field** = 11 × 14 = 154 m².

Area of **circular field** = πr² = 154.

Since 154 is a standard value for a circle with **radius (r)** = 7 m.

**Circumference** = 2πr = 2 × (22/7) × 7 = 44 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 44 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Length (l) = 14 m, Breadth (b) = 11 m, Area of Circle = Area of Rectangle.

**Formula Used:** Area of rectangle = l × b; Area of circle = πr²; Circumference = 2πr.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286ae3a86a357eb64fd2d3b2b9ff41b6d9487c52d637b3532552ee3bc34f5d7a.png] 

⇒ Area of **rectangular field** = 14 × 11 = 154 m²

⇒ Area of **circular field** = πr² = 154

⇒ (22/7) × r² = 154

⇒ r² = (154 × 7) ÷ 22

⇒ r² = 7 × 7 ⇒ r = 7 m

⇒ **Circumference** = 2 × (22/7) × 7

⇒ **Circumference** = 44 m

**∴ The correct answer is 44 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area and Circumference of Circle

Area = πr² and Circumference = 2πr, where r is the **radius** of the circle.

Rectangular Area

Area of a **rectangle** is the product of its length and breadth (L × B).

Standard Circle Values

For r = 7, Area = 154 and Circumference = 44. For r = 14, Area = 616 and Circumference = 88.</p
